text:
Your biggest enemy isn't rejection. It's being too available.

It's 11 p.m. You liked her photo. Watched her story. Commented twice this week.

She sees your name and thinks nothing.

Not because you are boring. Because you are everywhere. That is the everywhere trap.

She already has 50 men doing this. YOU ARE NOISE.

Your attention has value only when it is rare.

Give it only to women who have earned it.

The man she chases is not the man who chased her.
caption:
Dating psychology fact: men with discipline over their attention are more attractive. Self improvement is not just the gym.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
#mindset #discipline #datingpsychology #selfimprovement #successhabits
